title: POC step 3: establish one evidenced logic-edit recipe and its integrity requirements
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix: establish whether one meaningful VI logic change is supported by available evidence before ordering the disk edit. Expected gain is docs/research/poc/edit-readiness.md and edit-readiness.json containing either one executable edit recipe with evidence or a bounded negative finding and possible exits. The next shaper reads the edit-readiness verdict to order an edit or deliver a documented POC failure. Existing README establishes full heap framing but explicitly leaves primitive meaning, integrity and compiled-cache consistency unresolved. No session can run LabVIEW; opening, behavior and runtime validity remain owner checks.

## Work
1. Reuse inspect_vi.py and the saved grammar. Do not repeat RSRC/decompression/framing research. Search the pinned source snapshots and their provenance for a primitive identity/replacement contract, constant encoding, BDPW integrity and compiled-code invalidation rules. Check whether LVparts-source.txt actually contains the relevant classes; a missing match is not proof that the format has no integrity rule. If a missing source is retrieved through permitted tools, pin its URL, revision, license and hash.
2. Prefer the smallest demonstrable semantic change. Either substantiate a compatible primitive replacement independently of the add.vi filename, or inspect at most 12 small public fixtures for a typed numeric/Boolean/string constant that contributes to logic. Names and raw integers alone are not semantic evidence. Do not assume 103 -> 104 means Add -> Subtract. Record fixture selection criteria, inspected paths/hashes and failures; no bulk dump of the actor-framework corpus.
3. For the selected route, document node/terminal connectivity, field type/value and exact original-byte spans, intended before/after meaning, evidence for the replacement, container rebuild requirements, applicable integrity updates and compiled-cache handling. Distinguish source-derived rules, byte observations and hypotheses. If no route is supported, state the precise missing evidence and two concrete exits, including what a controlled fixture pair would resolve.
4. Save small offline probes and their results under docs/research/poc/step3/ as useful; do not produce an edited VI, change benchmark/product code or promote hypotheses to behavior claims. Write edit-readiness.md early and update it. Add a short link in the existing README without rewriting previous evidence. Delete the tracked inspect_vi .pyc if it is present.
5. Provide verify_edit_readiness.py that checks the saved evidence schema, cited local evidence and recorded hashes/spans where available, including rejection of incomplete recipes labelled ready. Its default run must use committed small evidence only, without the prepared environment, network, LabVIEW or .session/report.md. A negative research result can pass the evidence check; that does not establish POC success.

## Acceptance
- [ ] edit-readiness.md and edit-readiness.json record verdict ready|partial|unsupported, inspected sources/fixtures, evidence links and unresolved requirements.
- [ ] A ready verdict includes an evidenced semantic change and all identified integrity/cache requirements; other verdicts name the exact blockers and possible exits without claiming impossibility beyond the inspected scope.
- [ ] No edited VI or LabVIEW behavior claim is produced; save-version preservation and owner runtime checks remain explicit.
- [ ] The README links the new result; the saved offline verification passes without environment or session files.

## Verification
python3 -I docs/research/poc/verify_edit_readiness.py

## Context
- docs/research/poc/README.md: measured framing, candidate offsets and explicit semantic/integrity gaps from accepted #468.
- docs/research/poc/inspect_vi.py and heap-labels.json: reuse the parser and contextual labels.
- docs/research/poc/source-provenance.json; LVheap-source.txt; LVmisc-source.txt; LVparts-source.txt: pinned research sources, inspect relevant slices only.
- Prepared pylavi/tests and actor-framework sources are read-only under LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT when available. If absent, use saved evidence and record the unavailable fixture inspection; do not rerun commands indefinitely or fabricate results.
- Do not run git commit; the parent commits. Keep code and text under docs/research/poc/, binary/large outputs under .session/artifacts/.

## Budget
Read only the named POC files and relevant source slices, plus at most 12 selected fixture VIs. Do not read whole add.json, benchmark JSON, journals or iteration records. Keep command output below 80 lines and hex below 128 bytes; save longer evidence to files. Limit source/fixture investigation to roughly the first 35 turns, then finalize the verdict, evidence and verifier within 60 turns. Stop searching when one supported route is established. Do not wait for owner fixtures or claim the cold-agent demonstration: a later fresh session must receive only the tool and a VI analysis it has never seen.
